strategies.instructions:
Use this strategy when people need to talk to an agent through Telegram. A Telegram sendMessage/sendPhoto tool is a service operation and does not receive conversations or bind them to an agent. The existing private Toolkit component provides Bot API transport, update normalization and a reply presenter; it is not a standalone MCP server or a complete host. Obtain the exact authorized component artifact identified in provenance, together with a compatible Python 3.11+ host and the pinned python-telegram-bot 22.7 parser when using update normalization. Do not run the consumer library installer for this unmapped strategy.
First agree the bot, admitted people/groups, target agent and reply audience with the host policy owner. The user or authorized operator creates or selects the bot in Telegram BotFather; transfer the token directly through the host protected secret-entry surface, never chat, tool arguments, package metadata or logs. This bot-token route is not a provider OAuth browser redirect. A host-owned authenticated getMe check can establish which bot the token represents, but does not authenticate incoming people or grant them access.
Choose exactly one active incoming delivery owner: long polling with a durably committed update cursor, or an HTTPS webhook whose host validates the selected secret_token header before admission. Registering/replacing/deleting a webhook changes provider state and needs the host selected authority. Preserve update IDs and durable deduplication before invoking the admitted agent. Host admission maps provider user/chat/thread facts to a principal and conversation, applies audience/requester ceilings, and chooses the target agent. Never promote payload IDs or group membership into trusted authorization.
After an admitted turn, use the reply presenter with the same host-authorized chat/topic and delivery owner. Preserve per-part receipts, unknown results and cancellation without automatic resend. Validate wrong-user/group/topic refusal, duplicate inbound delivery, restart and uncertain outbound results before enabling the frontend. Confirm BotFather privacy mode, bot membership and actual update visibility for the selected chats without silently widening permissions. Incoming routing, authentication, lifecycle, secrets and durable delivery remain host integration work; this catalog entry supplies guidance, not readiness.
